Name: The Stray Catfe - UPDATE
Author: ch20youk
Description:
Latest update: Wizadroid has made seasonal versions of the vanilla portraits, available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18059]here[/url]! Please go check them out ^^

[quote]﻿﻿Meet Theo and Tabitha, a pair of twins who have just moved to the valley. Bubbly Tabitha came to Pelican Town to start a cafe with her pragmatic twin brother Theo in tow. Tabitha's go-getter attitude is inspiring, but can she really succeed on that alone? And is this really what Theo wants to do with his life? Talk to, befriend, and even romance your new neighbors to find out.[/quote]
This is an updated version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5533]The Stray Catfe[/url], a mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/12238318]alistairweekend[/url]. As the original mod never progressed past the beta stage, I received permission from the author to handle updates for compatibility with newer versions of Stardew Valley.

(I've made a [b]wiki[/b] [url=https://github.com/cl4r3/The-Stray-Catfe/wiki]here[/url] with all the typical information you might be looking for.)

This "1.0" version contains [b]all[/b] of the original content, as well as:[list]
[*]Updated sprites by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/70148453]AirynS[/url]﻿, including beach sprites
[*]Vanilla-style portraits by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/70148453]AirynS[/url]﻿, along with config options
[*]Seasonal custom exteriors for the cafe by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2893756]Yri[/url]﻿
[*]Custom spouse patios for both characters
[/list][list]
[*]Compatibility with Stardew Valley 1.5.6
[*]Removal of the PyTK requirement (replaced by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]EML[/url]﻿)
[/list][list]
[*]General compatibility with both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]RSV[/url]﻿﻿
[*]The pond outside the cafe now being fishable
[*]Forage and artifacts spawning outside the cafe
[*]i18n-friendly dialogue (for translators)
[*]Minor bug fixes from the original mod
[*]﻿Compatibility with Immersive Farm 2 Remastered (from SVE), Grandpa's Farm (from SVE) thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/397736]ASLaneZero[/url], and DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/url]
[/list]
There are still several things I have [b]yet to implement[/b] but do plan to, such as:
[list]
[*]Movie theater dialogue + reactions
[*]Summit dialogue
[*]14 heart events
[*]In-law dialogue
[*]Yearly check-ups with Harvey
[*]Night Market visits
[*]Toggleable interactions with vanilla characters
[*]Interactions with characters from other mods
[/list]And a few other things just for fun.

[b]Note:[/b] This mod is incompatible with any mod that completely rewrites the Bus Stop map. Since that's generally regarded to be a bad practice, I recommend you ask the creators of such mods to consider using a Content Patcher map patch to edit the map instead.

For information about the mod and its characters, please refer to the description of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5533]original mod[/url]﻿. Feel free to ask any questions here in the comments section. Report bugs in the comments section, and once confirmed, I'll post them to the bugs section. Thanks, and hope you enjoy!

[url=https://github.com/cl4r3/The-Stray-Catfe]Github repo[/url]
